name: Liddy
source:
"Hi there! I'm Liddy! I'm the director at Enigma Corp. I oversee World's Odyssey! I just wish Shiina Ninomiya the best of luck!"

A director at Enigma Corp. She served as the assistant director of World's Odyssey, and now takes the role of director for its sequel, End to Odyssey. Even after [url=/c160573]Shiina[/url] and the core team left Enigma, she chose not to follow them to Iris Corp. and stayed behind.

It's not that she has a bad relationship with Shiina and the others, but she has different ideas. It'll be [url=/c160572]Sayaka's[/url] first time meeting her, but as for the God of Death... who knows? Wasn't she in a hospital room somewhere...?

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category3&ch=liddy]official website[/url]]
